business.text: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd operates as an electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider, delivering design and manufacturing solutions for diverse markets including mobile phones, consumer electronics, and home appliances. The company sells its products to domestic and global brand owners under a business-to-business (B2B) model. It generates revenue through the sale of manufactured goods, provision of services, job work charges, and operating revenues.

bull.point: Operating cash flow exceeded PAT in FY26 at 108% of profit, supporting disciplined execution and financial foundation.

cites.label: Reported financials
cites.text: Operating cash flow exceeded PAT in 4 of the last 5 years (latest FY26: 108% of PAT).

bull.point: Mobile production volume is targeted around 34 million units in FY27 supported by anchor customers like Motorola and export expansion.
Semi-automatic washing machine volumes grew by 16% year-on-year to 1.3 lakh units for the first half year ended September 2026.

bear.point: Q2 FY27 PAT declined by 44.9% year-on-year, reflecting margin pressures and input cost volatility.

cites.label: Reported financials
cites.text: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹21,794 cr, +46.7% YoY, EBITDA margin 2.7%, PAT -44.9% YoY.

bear.point: Profitability in washing machines and refrigerators was temporarily affected by fluctuations in polymer prices, freight costs, and foreign exchange.
Global memory prices increased sharply due to supply rationalization, capacity constraints, and strong AI demand, creating input cost pressures.
